scientific_question: Can one accepted ROM1AR2 physical profile be reseeded at different absolute committed times and produce an identical one-window pure-hydraulics Reference response, establishing that library-generation time is not physical state for the C01 carrier?

audit_origin.selection_rule: lexicographically first state by (SPLIT,HISTORY,STEP) satisfying SPLIT=DISCOVERY and FALLBACK=F

carrier.source: qualified GC-RZM06C01 F-ROM1A-I0 16x10-cm B01 Reference carrier

time_pair.rule: Both probes have identical duration and forcing; only absolute committed/provenance time differs.

qualification_gate: both seeds reconstruct the exact same 16-node H/theta physical state
both strict Reference samples are valid, mass complete, one physical advance and zero automatic retries
each sample leaves its committed origin unchanged
candidate pressure_head, water_content, ponding_depth and groundwater_level are bitwise identical between A and B
bottom_outward_exchange_native and terminal_bottom_outward_flux_native are bitwise identical
all non-provenance mass and solver-count fields are bitwise/integer identical
candidate origin interval differs only by the preregistered absolute time shift
source_audit_basis: fmr_new_b110_committed_state accepts an explicit initial_time while cloning the physical state
kernel_sample_reference_floor_interval requires t0 to match committed time but supplies a one-step no-retry Reference floor
fmr_serialized_advance uses step_duration=t1-t0 for the base hydraulic request
C01 BASE layout disables legacy SWBOTB2 time control, snow, soil temperature, drainage response, root uptake, Black/Boesten evaporation and temporal-history state
decision_if_pass: QUALIFIED_COMMON_TIME_RESEED_FOR_PURE_HYDRAULICS; a later response-blind selector may compare strict DISCOVERY profiles generated at different library times because selected profiles will be reseeded to the same new committed time.
decision_if_fail: COMMON_TIME_RESEED_NOT_QUALIFIED; retain same-time constraint and do not broaden H2 origin selection.
controls: D02 uses one provenance-selected audit state only and performs no H2 pair search
no held-out or FALLBACK=T state access
nonclaims: D02 does not support or falsify H2
time neutrality applies only to this pure-hydraulics C01 carrier profile, not process-active SWAP configurations
